limits.randomSource: gnm-random.c: MT19937 seeded by unsigned UTF-8 bytes from GNUMERIC_PRNG_SEED; absent seed uses /dev/urandom with MT fallback. Polar normal generator caches a second draw; draw ordering and recalc effects affect streams. Injected deterministic randomness tests do not establish Gnumeric seed parity.
limits.randomDriverWeakness: t2003-random-generators.pl ignores failure except USER welinder or aguelzow; do not inherit this as product success. Ten CHECK1 suites are disabled with #if 0.
